text:
F-wur7 (Leuven, KU Leuven Bibliotheken Bijzondere Collecties, Ms. 1378): source-assisted reading, made with the image-only first reading and the Milan 1490 edition of Guido de Baysio, Apparatus ad Sextum (BSB bsb00065588, fol. 40r-40v) in hand. Lines reread on the native images by a research reader: canvas 4 (fol. [1]v A) lines 1-3 of the left block, the lines from "[debito]res sumus" to the gloss on Permittimus, four lines of the age passage; canvas 5 (fol. [1]v B) five lines of the right block. The passage on canvas 4, box 150,2020,2100,2660, is the coordinator's reading. Readings that two blind readers did not confirm are withdrawn and marked [not securely read]. All other lines of the leaf rest on the first reading only. Expansions in parentheses; [..] lost or unread; (?) uncertain. Boxes are native pixels (canvases 4 and 5 are 3849 x 5170).
